theater: 旁遮普與查穆河谷戰線

battle.name: 第二次印巴戰爭
battle.theater: 旁遮普與查穆河谷戰線
battle.brief: 一九六五年八月起，巴基斯坦以「直布羅陀」與「大滿貫」兩度出手，印軍在旁遮普與查穆河谷反攻，戰線自錫亞爾科特拉、克海姆卡蘭到昌溫達。印軍裝甲師仍大量裝備美製M4A1雪曼坦克，與巴軍M47、M48巴頓在公路與蔗田上正面相撞；昌溫達一役之後，雪曼退出這條戰線的主幹，換上百夫長與AMX-13。

kit.name: M4A1雪曼坦克
kit.history: M4A1雪曼坦克是二戰期間美國主力中型坦克，後來退役或轉讓至盟友，1965年巴基斯坦軍隊在印巴戰爭中將其作為裝甲突擊骨幹使用。

countries: 交戰雙方是印度共和國與巴基斯坦伊斯蘭共和國，真正打到坦克與空軍的只有旁遮普與查穆河谷兩條戰線。巴基斯坦由總統兼最高軍政首腦阿尤布·汗拍板，陸軍參謀長穆罕默德·穆薩中將主持全局：西線由第四軍守住信德與哈吉皮爾、卡奇一線，錫亞爾科特拉至查姆布的正面交給第十一軍，阿克諾爾山區由第十二軍與獨立打擊部隊經營，裝甲部隊則集中作機動突擊。第十一軍軍長阿克塔爾·侯賽因少將指揮查姆布方向攻勢；第一裝甲師師長拉赫曼少將率M47、M48巴頓沿拉合爾至阿姆利則公路東進，第六裝甲師師長阿布拉爾·侯賽因少將率裝甲部隊在錫亞爾科特拉方向投入昌溫達戰役，第四、第十、第十五、二十五步兵師與沙漠部隊接續投入。印度方面由總理拉爾·巴哈杜爾·夏斯特里與國防部長查萬主持，陸軍參謀長薩姆·馬內克肖中將自一九六五年一月接任後統一調度新德里陸軍總部：旁遮普歸第四軍，師長尼蘭詹·普拉薩德少將的第十五步兵師負責伊喬吉爾運河一線，第四、第五步兵師與山地部隊在側翼封控，第二、第四裝甲師與獨立裝甲旅在公路上佈防。雙方的編制、番號與任務劃分都以英軍留下的框架為底，再由美製武器重新裝備。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Republic of India and the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, but it was only on two fronts, the Punjab and the Jammu Valley, that tanks and aircraft actually met. On the Pakistani side President Ayub Khan made the decisions and Chief of Army Staff General Muhammad Musa ran the campaign: the western flank was held by IV Corps along the Sind, Hajipir and Rann lines, the Sialkot-Chhamb front was assigned to XI Corps, the Akhnoor hills were run by XII Corps and independent strike forces, and the armoured units were concentrated for mobile attacks. Major General Akhtar Hussain, commanding XI Corps, directed the offensive on the Chhamb axis; Major General A. A. Rahman led the 1st Armoured Division with M47 and M48 Pattons up the Lahore-Amritsar road, while Major General Abrar Hussain led the 6th Armoured Division into the Chawinda fighting in the Sialkot sector, and the 4th, 10th, 15th and 25th Infantry Divisions and the Desert Force followed in. On the Indian side Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri and Defence Minister Y. B. Chavan directed the effort, and General Sam Manekshaw, who took over as Chief of Army Staff in January 1965, ran everything from Army Headquarters in New Delhi: the Punjab fell under IV Corps, Major General Niranjan Prasad commanded the 15th Infantry Division responsible for the Ichhogil canal line, the 4th and 5th Infantry Divisions and the mountain troops held the flanks, and the 2nd and 4th Armoured Divisions and the independent armoured brigades covered the roads. On both sides the order of battle, unit designations and mission assignments still rested on the framework inherited from the British army, refitted in places with American weapons.
people: 策劃層面，巴基斯坦總統阿尤布·汗是整場戰爭的作者，他認定印軍在縱深、補給與士氣上都不如已經建制化的巴軍，只要在克什米爾方向重擊一次就能迫使新德里回到談判桌；陸軍參謀長穆薩中將把全軍作戰分成克什米爾與旁遮普兩個方向，使新德里無法判明主攻方向，最終把戰爭拖進自己擅長的裝甲與空軍優勢區。印軍這邊，陸軍參謀長馬內克肖中將堅持先鞏固後反擊，國防部長查萬與總理夏斯特里授權空軍在旁遮普自由出擊，第四軍軍長克海姆·辛格·薩曼塔爾中將在前線統一指揮。戰術層面的關鍵人物包括第十一軍軍長阿克塔爾·侯賽因少將、第一裝甲師師長拉赫曼少將、第六裝甲師師長阿布拉爾·侯賽因少將、第十五步兵師師長尼蘭詹·普拉薩德少將、第一裝甲師旅長薩普蘭、第四步兵師師長魯德拉，以及朱特營營長海德中校。連級的細節同樣被記錄：多格雷的失守與反攻、查姆布「匕首」縱隊的推進、旁遮普沙漠中部落民兵與駱駝分隊的襲擾，都有具體的指揮者被寫進戰史。至於誰算取勝，兩方標準從一開始就不一致：巴方以奪取查姆布與阿赫努爾為準，印方以逼退巴軍裝甲、恢復戰前態勢為準，戰後各執一詞。
peopleEn: Planning was the work of the President of Pakistan, Ayub Khan, who was the author of the whole war: he judged that the Indian army was weaker in depth, logistics and morale than the Pakistani army that had already been regularised, and that one heavy blow in Kashmir would force New Delhi back to the negotiating table. General Musa, the Chief of Army Staff, split the campaign into a Kashmir direction and a Punjab direction so that New Delhi could not read the main thrust, and eventually dragged the war into the zone where Pakistani armour and air power held the advantage. On the Indian side General Manekshaw insisted on consolidation before counterattack, Defence Minister Chavan and Prime Minister Shastri gave the Air Force freedom of action over the Punjab, and Lieutenant General Khem Singh Samantar commanded on the front. At the tactical level the key figures include Major General Akhtar Hussain of XI Corps, Major General A. A. Rahman of the 1st Armoured Division, Major General Abrar Hussain of the 6th Armoured Division, Major General Niranjan Prasad of the 15th Infantry Division, Brigadier Thapan of the 1st Armoured Division, Brigadier Rudra of the 4th Infantry Division, and Lieutenant Colonel Hayde commanding the Jat battalion. Company-level detail is recorded just as carefully: the loss and the recapture of Dograi, the advance of the Dagger force towards Chhamb, and the harassment carried out by tribal levies and camel detachments in the Punjab desert all have named commanders in the campaign histories. As for who had won, the two sides never shared a criterion: Pakistan measured success by taking Chhamb and Akhnoor, India by halting the Pakistani armoured thrust and restoring the pre-war situation, and each has stuck to its own account since.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是美製M4A1雪曼中型坦克，一九四二年量產，二戰後期是同盟國陸軍的裝甲主力，戰後大量外銷，印度與巴基斯坦都曾接收。規格上M4A1作戰全重約三十六噸，乘員五人，汽油機最大功率約一千四百二十五馬力，公路時速可達四十八公里，標準裝備七十六毫米口徑砲，另有七十五毫米砲型與一百零五毫米榴彈砲型，正面裝甲六十三毫米，七十六毫米砲備彈約六十三發。走上一九六五年旁遮普的公路時，雪曼的處境已經很典型：跑得快、轉向靈活，卻皮薄、射程短、靠前裝甲硬吃反戰車砲，長距離追擊極耗油，車體又不耐航。印度軍方仍以M4系列編成第一、第二、第四裝甲師及獨立裝甲旅的核心，其中一部分加裝一百零五毫米自走榴彈砲，專職支援步兵突破，第一裝甲師在昌溫達的推進就是以雪曼集群打頭陣。巴基斯坦的裝甲突擊骨幹則是同樣來自美國的M47與M48巴頓中型坦克、M24查菲輕坦克，另有英製百夫長；關於巴軍序列中少量M4A1雪曼的存在與分屬，各家記載並不一致，可確定的是本役兩場最著名的坦克對決，都是美製裝甲之間的碰撞。火炮方面，雙方以二十五磅砲、三點七英寸榴彈砲、十七磅反戰車砲與自走砲配合步兵；徵召的部落民兵、駱駝隊與騎兵分隊則補上裝甲與車輛的缺口。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face is the American M4A1 Sherman medium tank, mass-produced from 1942, the armour mainstay of the Allied armies in the later part of the Second World War and exported in large numbers afterwards, to India and to Pakistan alike. In specification the M4A1 weighs roughly thirty-six tonnes in combat order, carries a crew of five and uses a petrol engine of about 1,425 horsepower, reaching some 48 km/h on roads. It carried a 76 mm gun as standard, with 75 mm and 105 mm howitzer variants also built, its frontal armour was 63 mm thick, and the 76 mm gun carried about 63 rounds. On the roads of the Punjab in 1965 the Sherman had reached a typical condition: fast and agile, but thinly plated, short-ranged, forced to absorb anti-tank gun hits on its frontal armour, thirsty of fuel over a long pursuit and short of endurance. The Indian army still built the core of its 1st, 2nd and 4th Armoured Divisions and of the independent armoured brigades on the M4 family, some of them fitted with 105 mm self-propelled howitzers for infantry support, and the 1st Armoured Division opened the advance at Chawinda with Sherman clusters. The backbone of the Pakistani armoured assault was instead the American M47 and M48 Patton medium tanks and the M24 Chaffee light tank, together with British Centurions; the existence and the exact allocation of a small number of M4A1 Shermans in the Pakistani order of battle are reported inconsistently, and what can be certain is that the two most famous tank duels of the campaign were collisions between American-built armoured formations. On the artillery side both armies used 25-pounder guns, 3.7-inch howitzers, 17-pounder anti-tank guns and self-propelled guns in support of infantry, while levied tribal irregulars, camel corps and mounted detachments made up for the gaps in armour and motor transport.
tactics: 巴基斯坦的戰法在開戰前已改寫成以公路與平原為舞臺的機械化突擊：第一步「直布羅陀」由山區滲透分隊在阿克諾爾一線進入，於八月前線在查姆布方向接應；第二步「大滿貫」由第十一軍各師在九月初攻取查姆布，切斷查姆布至傑穆的公路；同時第一裝甲師沿拉合爾至阿姆利則公路東進，第六裝甲師在錫亞爾科特拉方向切斷印軍側翼。進攻樣板是坦克密集的縱隊加摩托化步兵，縱隊之間保持互相可射擊的距離，目標是分割敵縱深、奪取橋頭與道路樞紐，用速度與縱深換裝甲優勢，裝甲突擊前先以空軍與砲兵壓制。印度這邊的反擊分三層：以空軍打擊巴軍縱隊與集結地、以第四軍在伊喬吉爾運河一線反衝、再以裝甲師在克海姆卡蘭正面對撞，必要時以山地步兵在側翼封住公路。雙方都吃了補給線的苦：油料前推、搶修被炸毀的公路橋樑、回收受損坦克都缺乏車輛，克海姆卡蘭一役大批巴頓被擊毀後無法回收、就地遺棄，正是回收能力不足的直接後果。制空權的爭奪同樣決定節奏，戰機在頭頂反覆掃射縱隊，行軍因此多在夜間與黎明進行，白晝則分散成疏散隊形。
tacticsEn: Pakistan's method of war had already been rewritten as a mechanised thrust fought on roads and plains: the first step, Operation Gibraltar, sent infiltration detachments across the Akhnoor line into the hills to open a front towards Chhamb in August; the second step, Operation Grand Slam, committed the divisions of XI Corps to take Chhamb in early September and cut the Chhamb-Jammu road; at the same time the 1st Armoured Division drove east along the Lahore-Amritsar road while the 6th Armoured Division cut the Indian flank in the Sialkot sector. The pattern of attack was a dense column of tanks with motorised infantry, the columns spaced so that they could support each other by fire, the objectives being to split the enemy in depth, seize bridgeheads and road junctions, and trade armour advantage for speed and reach, with air strike and artillery softening the ground before the armour went in. India's counterattack had three layers: air strikes against Pakistani columns and assembly areas, a counterstroke by IV Corps along the Ichhogil canal, and a head-on armoured collision at Khem Karan, with mountain infantry sealing the roads on the flank when needed. Both sides suffered from the long supply line: fuel had to be pushed forward, bombed road bridges had to be repaired, and there were too few recovery vehicles; the mass of Pattons destroyed at Khem Karan and abandoned where they lay was a direct result of that shortage in recovery capacity. The struggle for air supremacy set the tempo as well, aircraft strafing the columns overhead, so movement was largely carried out at night and at dawn, with daylight columns dispersed into a looser order.
data: 可引用的數字不少，但口徑不一。戰役自一九六五年四月邊境衝突起，九月一日全面升級，九月十日零時聯合國停火生效，主戰期不足兩週；各國軍史多採印度陣亡約三千人、巴基斯坦陣亡約三千八百人的說法，亦有把雙方合計推高到一萬以上的更高估計。領土上，印度軍控制巴基斯坦約一千九百二十平方公里，巴基斯坦軍控制印度約五百五十平方公里，巴方另稱佔領約一千六百平方公里。坦克損失以克海姆卡蘭與昌溫達兩役最常被引述：克海姆卡蘭一役約九十七輛巴軍巴頓被擊毀或遺棄，印軍損失三十二輛坦克；昌溫達一役印度第一裝甲師損失數十輛至近百輛坦克，數字在各家戰史之間有出入。裝備存量上，印度軍方一九六五年前後仍保有約八百輛各型M4雪曼、數百輛百夫長與一批AMX-13、PT-76及中國製59式；巴基斯坦軍方則有逾二百輛M47、M48巴頓，數十輛M24查菲與約一百五十輛英製百夫長。一九五四年美巴防務條約換來約七億美元美援，是這些數字的來源。停火於一九六五年九月十日零時生效，談判在塔什干進行，宣言於一九六六年一月十日簽署，俘獲人員其後大批交換回返。
dataEn: There are plenty of figures to quote, but the counting methods differ. The conflict began as border fighting in April 1965, escalated fully on 1 September, and a United Nations ceasefire took effect at zero hour on 10 September, so the main fighting lasted less than two weeks. National military histories commonly give about 3,000 Indian dead and about 3,800 Pakistani dead, while other estimates push the combined total well above 10,000. In territory, the Indian forces held about 1,920 square kilometres of Pakistan and the Pakistani forces about 550 square kilometres of India, Pakistan claiming a further 1,600 square kilometres. Tank losses are most often cited from Khem Karan and Chawinda: at Khem Karan roughly 97 Pakistani Pattons were destroyed or abandoned while India lost thirty-two tanks; at Chawinda the Indian 1st Armoured Division lost from several dozen tanks to close on a hundred, and the figures differ between campaign histories. On equipment holdings, the Indian army still had about 800 M4 Shermans of various types around 1965, several hundred Centurions and a batch of AMX-13, PT-76 and Chinese Type 59; the Pakistani army had more than 200 M47 and M48 Pattons, several dozen M24 Chaffees and roughly 150 British Centurions. The 1954 US-Pakistan defence agreement, worth around 700 million dollars in American aid, is the source of these numbers. The ceasefire took effect at zero hour on 10 September 1965, the talks were held at Tashkent, the declaration was signed on 10 January 1966, and prisoners of war were exchanged in large numbers afterwards.
cause: 開戰的起因沒有單一說法，但可確定的是幾條線纏在一起。其一是實力差距的逆轉：印度在一九六二年中印邊境戰爭失利後獲得美英與西德大批軍援，兵力與裝備迅速膨脹；巴基斯坦自一九五四年起靠美援建立了規模較小但素質較高的空軍與裝甲部隊，艾尤布·汗擔心印度完成國防現代化之後差距只會更大，於是選擇在窗口仍開的時候主動出手。其二是克什米爾與卡奇兩處爭端同時發酵：一九六五年四月至六月，兩國在卡奇蘭恩與信德至哈吉皮爾一線互相襲擊對方哨所，巴軍一度攻下坎賈科特，六月底雖同意把爭端交國際法院仲裁，但山區滲透分隊已無法收回，策劃者擔心拖延便前功盡棄。其三是外交失敗：英國與美國先後勸阻不成，巴基斯坦指望蘇聯與中國的態勢會嚇阻印度，印度則認為西方會在邊界問題上站在自己一邊。其四是雙方指揮部都判斷對方不會全面承擔國際風險，於是最初的有限行動一路升級為全面戰爭，而開戰之後的計劃外擴張又回過頭把兩個選項都收窄。
causeEn: There is no single account of what caused the war, but several threads can be identified with certainty. The first is the reversal of the balance of strength: after its defeat in the 1962 Sino-Indian border war India received large deliveries from the United States, Britain and West Germany, and its manpower and equipment grew rapidly; from 1954 Pakistan had built a smaller but far better armoured and air force on American aid, and Ayub Khan feared that once India finished modernising, the gap would only widen, so he chose to strike while the window was still open. The second is that the Kashmir and Rann disputes flared at the same time: between April and June 1965 the two armies raided each other's outposts along the Rann of Kutch and the Sind-Hajipir line, the Pakistanis briefly taking Kanjkot, and although the end of June brought agreement to refer the dispute to international arbitration, the infiltration detachments in the hills could not be recalled, and the planners feared that any delay would waste what had been achieved. The third is the failure of diplomacy: British and American discouragement failed, Pakistan expected Soviet and Chinese pressure to deter India, and India assumed the Western powers would back it on the boundary question. The fourth is that both commands judged the other would not accept the full international risk, so limited opening moves escalated step by step into a general war, and the unplanned expansion that followed narrowed both sides' options in turn.
impact: 戰爭的直接後果是停火與《塔什干宣言》：一九六五年九月十日聯合國停火生效，一九六六年一月十日兩國總理在塔什干簽署宣言，恢復戰前態勢。這份宣言並未解決克什米爾主權、邊界劃線與印度河用水分配三項根本爭議，恰恰相反，它把爭議原封不動地擱到下一個十年，直接為一九七一年第三次印巴戰爭、一九七二年《西姆拉協定》與控制線的確認埋下伏筆。軍事上，雙方都認定自己吃過補給與回收的苦，於是加速換裝：印度的M4雪曼在七十年代初退盡，百夫長與AMX-13整編上來；巴基斯坦也在同期引進新型主戰坦克並擴充國防工業。政治上，艾尤布·汗因戰果未達預期而聲望受損，一九六八年之後的接班危機與一九七一年政變都以此為背景。國際上，這場戰爭顯示美國對南亞盟國的約束力有限，華盛頓在一九六六年之後同時加強與印度的防務關係，印巴兩國在冷戰格局中同時向美國靠攏的時代就此結束。
impactEn: The direct consequences of the war were the ceasefire and the Tashkent Declaration: the United Nations ceasefire took effect on 10 September 1965, and on 10 January 1966 the two prime ministers signed a declaration in Tashkent restoring the situation that had existed before the war. The declaration settled none of the three root issues, the status of Kashmir, the drawing of the boundary and the sharing of the Indus waters, and on the contrary it set them aside untouched into the next decade, feeding directly into the Third Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, the Simla Agreement of 1972 and the confirmation of the Line of Control. Militarily both sides concluded they had been punished by their own logistics and recovery arrangements and hurried to re-equip: the M4 Shermans were run down in India in the early 1970s as Centurions and AMX-13 were reorganised in, while Pakistan imported new main battle tanks and expanded its own defence industry in the same period. Politically, Ayub Khan's prestige suffered when the campaign fell short of expectations, a fact that lies behind the succession crisis after 1968 and the coup of 1971. Internationally, the war showed the limits of American leverage over South Asian allies, and after 1966 Washington strengthened its defence relationship with India at the same time; the era in which India and Pakistan both leaned towards the United States within the Cold War order came to an end.
result: 打完之後的戰場結果是一條拉鋸線：巴基斯坦在克什米爾方向一度得手，攻下查姆布與阿赫努爾、推進至哈吉皮爾山口，印軍則在西線擋下巴軍裝甲師於克海姆卡蘭，收復查姆布，並在聯合國停火生效時把戰線推回大致戰前的位置。巴方宣稱達到戰略目標、遏制了對方的領土野心，印方宣稱粉碎了進攻並保住了旁遮普，兩邊都宣布勝利，這也是這場戰爭至今被兩國分別追憶為正義之戰與侵略之戰的原因。真正確定的結果有三項：一是九月十日停火與次年一月十日的《塔什干宣言》，二是龐大的傷亡與坦克損失帶來的軍備競賽加速，三是戰爭並未解決任何一項根本爭議，反而把雙方的對抗推向更高強度，直接引出後來的另一場大規模戰爭。
resultEn: What the battlefield finally produced was a line of balance: Pakistan had the better of the fighting in Kashmir for a time, taking Chhamb and Akhnoor and pushing up to the Hajipir Pass, while in the west the Indian army held the Pakistani armoured divisions at Khem Karan, retook Chhamb, and by the time the United Nations ceasefire took effect had pushed the front back to roughly its pre-war position. Pakistan declared that its strategic aims had been met and the other side's territorial ambitions checked, India declared that the offensive had been broken and the Punjab saved, and both claimed victory, which is why the war is still remembered in the two countries as a just war and as an aggression. Three results are genuinely certain: the ceasefire of 10 September and the Tashkent Declaration of the following January; a very heavy cost in dead and in tanks, which accelerated the arms race; and the fact that the war settled none of the underlying disputes, but instead drove the confrontation to a higher intensity and led directly to a later large-scale war.
